column1: # G12 phase 10: identity(v, r) -- a resource's identity on its alias
# section 10). The record names the resource's $id, an absolute URI
# with no fragment, its $anchor, which is a plain name, and the key it
# had under $defs. Value-transparent: the value unifies and generates
# exactly as v. Only an alias declaration carries the record, from a
# call that is its value rather than another call's argument; a
# reference's copy never does, and two records at one declaration meet
# as a key-wise union. Neither canon nor generation shows the record:
# the JSON Schema export reads it, and test/spec/jsonschema.tsv pins
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).
